title: UAAP: Staying ready, Luke Felipe helps FEU nail crucial win

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Far Eastern University’s Final Four bid got a spark from an unsung hero on Sunday. Facing top team National University, young gunslinger Luke Felipe gave the Tamaraws a big lift in an 85-63 rout of the Bulldogs. Felipe said his readiness allowed him to step up at a crucial time, tallying 14 points on 4-of-6 shooting from long range, two rebounds and a steal in just 12 minutes and 19 seconds off the bench.
